body:
在与阿尔茨海默病和路易体痴呆症抗争后，英国演员Patrick Stewart于美国当地10月28日在洛杉矶的家中去世，享年86岁（1940.07.13-2026.10.28）。
Stewart爵士的代表影视角色包括“星际迷航”系列中的Jean-Luc Picard和漫威“X战警/变种人”系列中的X教授Charles Xavier。
其代表方发布声明证实了这一消息：
We announce with great sorrow the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart yesterday at his home in Los Angeles, in the loving care of his beloved wife Sunny, following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia,” the statement reads. “He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter, and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all. We will forever cherish the peaceful ease and reflection on his face, an enduring reminder of his invincible grace.
